capabilities: record microphone input as 16 kHz mono WAV files in the vault
transcribe recordings locally with whisper-cli and a GGML Whisper model
write Markdown notes with transcript timestamps that link back to the audio
generate optional Codex summaries, decisions, tasks, and open questions linked to transcript segments
recover saved audio chunks, pending transcripts, and failed note writes through a Recovery Center
extras: macOS desktop only (no Windows, Linux, or mobile); captures one microphone input, not system or meeting-app audio; no telemetry or plugin-side payments; listing carries a note that it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record microphone audio and turn it into a note with a transcript whose timestamps link back to the recording.

relations.evidence: Codex is not required for recording or local transcription.
If <vault-config-dir>/plugins/codex-recording-minutes/data.json exists, the new plugin offers a user-initiated, read-only index import

requires.name: whisper-cli (whisper.cpp) and a GGML Whisper model
OpenAI account (sign-in and quota) for optional Codex summaries

summary: macOS plugin that records microphone audio to WAV in the vault, transcribes it locally with whisper-cli, and writes timestamped, source-linked Markdown notes.
